text: As required by the City's Investment Policy, the purpose of this report is to provide the Toronto Investment Board (Board) with the following: 1. The Sinking Fund and Long Term Fund performance for the second quarter of 2026. 2. Investment Policy and Plan Compliance check for the second quarter of 2026. 3. Supplementary comparative information for the Board’s real estate investments.

The Toronto Investment Board: 1. Adopted the INREV Global Real Estate Fund Index (GREFI), as presented in Confidential Attachment 2 to the revised report (September 24, 2026) from the Director, Capital Markets and Treasury, as supplementary comparative information for purposes of reviewing the performance of the Board’s real estate investments. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the revised report (September 24, 2026) from the Director, Capital Markets and Treasury remain confidential in their entirety, as they contain information that involves the security of property belonging to the City or one of its agencies or corporations.
